杨童眼神也是不由一个闪亮。

“你上次来是什么时候？”

胡九郎回答道：

“两年前……”

杨童若有所思。

这说明这个地方在两年前还是正常的，这还真的跟异能者失踪的事件对的上，第一个异能者失踪差不多也是在两年前。

只是当时没有引起注意，渐渐地异能者失踪越来越多，749局才重视起来。

“你怎么找到这个地方的？”

胡九郎摊开双手。

“你自己看周围的桃树便是！这里的桃树，差不多是南方最好的了，我来这个地方取桃木，实在是再正常不过的事情了！”

众人踏入古镇，脚下的石板年久失修，发出“吱呀”的轻响，像是活物在呼吸。

街道两旁的店铺门窗破败，布幌垂落，积满灰尘，却没有一片落叶，没有一只飞鸟，安静得只剩下几人的呼吸与脚步声，连风都像是被抽走了声音。

这里处处透着一股诡异，杨童也是皱起眉头。

“有人吗？”

杨童喊了一声，声音在空荡的镇子里回荡，却只传回细碎的回声。

就在这时，一道纤细的身影从街角缓缓走了出来。

女人穿着素白的长裙，长发松松挽起，面容清秀，气质干净得像山间的雾，眼神却空茫又古怪，像是活在自己的世界里。

她站在不远处，静静地看着他们，不说话，也不靠近，就那样静静伫立，像一幅画里走出来的人。

“你是谁？”

杨童立刻上前一步，将众人护在身后，拿出专用的灵力探测仪，屏幕上却一片乱码。

“这里的灵力干扰太强，探测不到她的具体等级。”

女人依旧不答，只是微微歪了歪头，嘴角勾起一抹极淡、极怪的笑。

她的笑容很轻，却让人莫名发毛，像是没有温度的木偶。

阡陌躲在胡九郎身后，小声道：

“大哥，她……她好奇怪……像一个伪人。”

胡九郎目光落在她身上，眉头微蹙。

他能感觉到这个女人身上没有恶意，却充满了诡异的秩序感，一举一动都像是被设定好的程序，没有情绪，没有波动，像一个行走的容器。

胡九郎想要给她看相，却发现在她的面貌上，根本看不出任何东西。

“夏未来。”

女人忽然开口，声音轻柔，却没有任何起伏，像是念台词。

Yang Tong's eyes couldn't help but shine.

"When was the last time you came here?"

Hu Jiulang replied:

"Two years ago..."

Yang Tong was thoughtful.

This shows that this place was still normal two years ago. This is really consistent with the incident of missing people with super powers. The first person with super powers disappeared almost two years ago.

It was just that no attention was paid to it at the time. Gradually, more and more people with powers disappeared, and only then did Bureau 749 pay more attention to it.

"How did you find this place?"

Hu Jiulang spread his hands.

"Just look at the peach trees around you! The peach trees here are almost the best in the south. It is absolutely normal for me to come to this place to pick up peach trees!"

When everyone stepped into the ancient town, the stone slabs under their feet were in disrepair and made a soft "squeaking" sound, like a living creature breathing.

The doors and windows of the shops on both sides of the street are dilapidated, the cloth is hanging down, and they are covered with dust, but there is not a fallen leaf or a flying bird. It is so quiet that only the breathing and footsteps of a few people are left, and even the wind seems to have been sucked away.

There was something strange everywhere here, and Yang Tong also frowned.

"Is there anyone?"

Yang Tong shouted, and his voice echoed in the empty town, but only tiny echoes came back.

At this moment, a slender figure slowly walked out from the corner of the street.

The woman was wearing a plain white dress, her long hair was rolled up loosely, her face was delicate, her temperament was as clean as the mist in the mountains, but her eyes were blank and strange, as if she was living in her own world.

She stood not far away and looked at them quietly, without speaking or getting closer. She just stood there quietly, like a person walking out of a painting.

"Who are you?"

Yang Tong immediately stepped forward, protected everyone behind him, and took out a special spiritual power detector, but the screen was full of garbled characters.

"The spiritual interference here is too strong and her specific level cannot be detected."

The woman still didn't answer, but tilted her head slightly, and a very faint and strange smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.

Her smile was very light, but it made people feel inexplicably hairy, like a puppet without warmth.

Qian Mo hid behind Hu Jiulang and whispered:

"Brother, she...she is so strange...like a pseudo-person."

Hu Jiulang's eyes fell on her and he frowned slightly.

He could feel that there was no malice in this woman, but she was full of a strange sense of order. Every move she made seemed to be programmed, with no emotions or fluctuations, like a walking container.

Hu Jiulang wanted to read her face, but found that there was nothing at all on her face.

"Xia Laiwei."

The woman suddenly spoke, her voice soft but without any ups and downs, as if she was reciting lines.
